lead_raw_text:
The structure of CaMg₁₂Sn crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a 28-atom unit cell and nine independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca and Sn each coordinated by 12 neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Mg centers display 10-, 12-, and 14-neighbor environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 10-vertex Mg polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between 10- and 12-vertex Mg polyhedra.
